description: An expander for the MIDI Recorder: five more columns of control voltage, each recorded as a MIDI control change on the recorder's ten tracks

inputs.text: Sends the voltage here as a control change on the track of its row, under the control number shown at the top of its column, 0-10V mapped to 0 to 127 unless that column's Input Range says otherwise

notes: this module records nothing on its own: it has to stand immediately to the right of a MIDI Recorder, or to the right of another MIDIRecorderCC that leads back to one
any number of these can be chained one after another to the right of the recorder
the five red displays at the top show the control number each column is recorded under; the columns start at control change 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, and each is changed from that column's menu
a row is recorded only when at least one jack in it has a cable, and only while the recorder itself is running
values are sampled 200 times a second, the rate the MIDI baud rate allows
nothing stops two columns from writing the same control number; with a column set to 14 bits at control change 2 and another set to control change 34, both write to control change 34
menu: CC#1 — opens the settings for the first column: its Input Range, its 14bit switch and its MIDI CC number
CC#2 — opens the settings for the second column
CC#3 — opens the settings for the third column
CC#4 — opens the settings for the fourth column
CC#5 — opens the settings for the fifth column
Input Range — in a column's submenu: sets the voltage span read from that column's jacks, from -10 to 10 down to 0 to 1
14bit — in a column's submenu: writes that column at 14-bit resolution as two control changes, the chosen number and that number plus 32; the second one is dropped if it would go past 127
MIDI CC — in a column's submenu: a box for typing that column's control change number
